description: List spaced repetition review dates for a topic at expanding intervals, so you revisit it just before you would forget it. Dates on or after the exam are marked to skip. Example prompt: "When should I review what I learned today for my exam on 2026-11-30?"

first_study_date.description: The day you first studied it. Defaults to today.

intervals_days.description: Days after the first study to review.

name: spaced_repetition_dates
title: Spaced repetition dates
